notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.notes:
Synchronization with the latest mobile release.... Ahh just kidding.

Sorry about the lack of detail with the last release, I was in a big hurry and I just wanted to throw something up. This release is me undoing the cloud save changes I had made previously. The new system I had went to was just too painful to deal with. In addition, I added a notification when you select default in cloud save, so what that does should be more clear. There's some other changes that only affect mobile players, but it's nice to keep all the versions in sync. 

If you experience any bugs after the update, feel free to reach out to me at support@wafflestackstudio.com

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
This update synchronizes everything with the latest Android version. iOS will follow shortly.

If you have any issues, send an email to support@wafflestackstudio.com or open a ticked on discord. Discord is usually faster.

Check the changelog for more details.
https://towerball.wafflestackstudio.com/home/change-log

-Ball count now persist when you quit the game and restart.
-Ladder updates more often for the client.
-Bronze Tier 
   -Ball health lowered
-Bugs Fixed
   -A major bug was found that accidently doubled the power of all towers.
   -A lot of changes are trying to mitigate the damage loss from this bug fix.
-Upgrade points now increase their cost by 30 instead of 40. 
    -This means you'll earn prestige points faster
-All tower damage gold upgrades have been increased
-All prestige point damage amounts have been increased.
-Gem Powerup "Increase Damage Upgrade" has been increased by .1 per level to .2
-Level 3 gold increased from 25 gold to 30
-Shard upgrade changes
   -Old shard upgrade removed (Increase All Towers Damage Upgrade Limit)
   -New shard upgrade (Gold Damage +0.1)

notes.title: Tournament Mode Update
notes.notes:
Hi all,
I took in a bunch of feedback from Steam and mobile users. This release is a result of that.

New Tournament
  -Players are now divided into blocks of 30.
  -The top 10 players of a block will be promoted to a new tier, if one exists.
  -The bottom 10 players will be demoted to the previous tier, if one exists.

I also finished converting all the text to textmesh, which let me remove a bunch of redundant fonts. This made the game size a lot smaller. The side effect is some text might be missing. Let me know if you see that.

Please email me with any issues you find at support@wafflestackstudio.com

notes.title: The Boss Fight Update
notes.notes:
Hi all!
 If you have more than 1 million upgrade points, a new boss fight will become available. Please let me know what you think of the new content!

Some of the new stuff
[list]
[*] A new boss fight.
[*] New levels after beating the boss
[*] Balls afflicted with the acid damage multiplier turn green if particle effects are turned off.
[*] Long press options added for Dark powerups, Light powerups and the permanent gold upgrades
[*] Fix for Polish language error on the upgrade points menu
[*] A special thanks page has been added for Discord Community Managers, Testers, and Translators
[/list]

Also, some of the translations are not yet completed. The community at discord is hard at work adding translations, but if you would like to help out, you can join us on discord https://discord.gg/cyXgpPz, or directly on Crowdin https://crowdin.com/project/tower-ball-localization/invite?d=d5l6q40545e5h543l4n46393f3

More Details :
https://towerball.wafflestackstudio.com/home/change-log

 I'll start work on the new UI on the development beta branch now. If you are on that branch, keep me posted with any opinions of what you see or recommendations you may have.
